title: RENDER：控制LLM记忆评估中的读者可见证据
summary: RENDER是一个基准控制方法，固定对话内容，改变读者可见的工件（如记忆条目、摘要、类型化记录或原始摘录），以评估其对LLM记忆和RAG性能的影响。在500个LongMemEval问题和9个模型上，匹配预算的解析包比截断原始对话高出42.4-72.6分。结果表明，记忆/RAG评估应报告或控制读者可见工件。
summary_en: RENDER is a benchmark control that fixes the conversation while varying the reader-facing artifact (e.g., memory entries, summaries, typed records, or raw excerpts) to assess its impact on LLM memory and RAG performance. On 500 LongMemEval questions and nine models, matched-budget resolved packets beat recency-truncated raw dialogue by 42.4-72.6 points. Results suggest memory/RAG evaluations should report or control the reader-facing artifact.
